stem.text: As blood flows from an artery to a vein, the blood pressure in the vessels changes. The four graphs represent data for blood vessels in the sequence shown.
Which graph shows these changes correctly?

A.alt: Graph of blood pressure against art, a, c, v and vein, with one curve.

B.alt: Graph of blood pressure against art, a, c, v and vein, with one curve.

C.alt: Graph of blood pressure against art, a, c, v and vein, with one curve.

D.alt: Graph of blood pressure against art, a, c, v and vein, with one curve.
